title: Saying who you are
summary: Say who you are, what you do, how you feel and where you are from with the personal pronouns and the short form of **to be** (*Men talyp*), and learn the last part of vowel harmony, rounding.
canDo: Say who you and other people are, and what they do
Say how you feel: tired, hungry, happy
Say your nationality and your home town, and ask someone else's
